declare
 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id, coll_date
 from units
 where batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

begin

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_NOTE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_note is
 note_exist boolean;
begin
 note_exist := true;
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x from note_books
 where note_id = :batch_inputs.note_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 note_exist := false;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if note_exist then
 begin
 update note_books
 set note = :s_note
 where note_id = :note_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select notebook_seq.nextval
 into :batch_inputs.note_id
 from dual;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into note_books
 (note_id,note)
 values (:batch_inputs.note_id, :s_note);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_INTERDICTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_interdiction is
 temp_count number;
 temp_coll_date date;
 temp_inter_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_max_temp number(5,2);
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 v_local_time date;
begin
 -- Commented vide IM 6947 
 --if is_timezone_enabled 
 -- then
 -- Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 --else
 -- v_local_time := sysdate;
 --end if;
 --
 -- TEMP interdiction
 --
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 inter_code in (
 select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'TEMP'
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)); -- SCR 18938
 --and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+365)); ----- IM 6947
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,sysdate) = 'Y')
 ;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count >= 1
 then
 if :batch_inputs.max_temp <= 37.5
 then
 -- interdiction 'TEMP' is no more required
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 inter_code in (
 select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'TEMP'
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)); -- SCR 18938
 -- and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+365) ----- IM 6947
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,sysdate) = 'Y'
 );
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 elsif temp_count = 0
 then
 if :batch_inputs.max_temp > 37.5
 then
 -- interdiction 'TEMP' has to be created for
 -- the unit
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction 
 (
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'TEMP',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 )
 ;
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions TEMP not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 -- CMT interdiction
 --
end;

and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(c.contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
